title: Python with mypy: Gradual Typing
description: mypy adds gradual static typing to Python, where annotated code is checked and unannotated code defaults to Any, which opts out of checking.

steps.description: Python gradual typing example with mypy.
Imports: typing Any for opt-out type.
Typed function: add(x: int, y: int) -> int enforces integer arguments.
Checked call: add('a', 3) triggers mypy error for incompatible type.
Any opt-out: untyped: Any = [] silences all checks for that variable.
